title: Allow an unexecuted migration-superseded reservation before the next amendment hold

trigger.denial: taskctl amendment materialize W1.A05 rejected the prospective state with `W1.A04: predecessor of the amendment-hold owner is not ADOPTED` and `W1.A04: terminal lifecycle did not restore ordinary Wave scope`.
trigger.atomicity: The failed validated save made no backlog mutation. W1.A05 remained APPROVED with no tasks or campaign, W1 remained PAUSED at ordinary Wave scope, and the protected W1.A04 historical witness remained untouched.
trigger.diagnosis: The controller can authenticate and append a previously approved but never materialized reservation as migration-superseded terminal history, but the shared amendment-hold invariant admitted only ADOPTED predecessors. The producer and consumer state machines therefore disagreed at the exact W1.A05 materialization boundary.

authority: This maintenance preserves the approved W1, W1.A04 terminal reservation, W1.A05 packet/bootstrap, task and slice inventory, governed experience, verification, and release-gate authority. It does not materialize or activate W1.A05 by itself, claim product work, expand acceptance criteria, authorize a release or external effect, alter the protected witness, or rewrite any approval, evidence, attempt, finding, closure, lifecycle event, migration, or predecessor history.

intendedDelta.implementation: Recognize one exact generic non-executable predecessor form in the amendment-hold finite-state table: exactly two lifecycle events ordered APPROVED then SUPERSEDED, a final actor matching governance-migration:GOV-MIG-NNNN, no bootstrap, no campaign, no tasks, and no completion review, exit-review control, or evidence. Such a reservation may precede the sole latest executable amendment owner and need not restore ordinary Wave scope while that later owner holds the Wave. ADOPTED predecessors retain their existing behavior.
failClosed: A SUPERSEDED predecessor with any bootstrap, campaign, task, completion review, completion evidence, non-migration supersession actor, or executable lifecycle event remains ineligible and blocks the hold transition.
WITHDRAWN and DEFERRED predecessors remain ineligible; the correction does not generalize acceptance to all terminal states.

The hold still requires exactly one latest executable amendment owner, and all other lifecycle, campaign, bootstrap, task-inventory, authority, evidence, compare-and-swap, and atomic-persistence checks still run.
The authenticated W1.A04 approval, ECR-0004 reservation, GOV-MIG-0001 migration reference, W1.A05 approval/bootstrap, and protected historical witness handling remain unchanged.

verification.riskAnalysis: The change touches the shared amendment-hold finite-state table and therefore evidence/control authority. Selected checks cover the exact positive predecessor form, bootstrap tampering, withdrawn predecessor denial, the complete taskctl schema/workflow suite, exact v4 ECR/reservation and governed-reference authority, all governed Python quality, canonical backlog semantics, generated backlog views, deterministic planning-site output, ECR-0004 history binding, and patch hygiene. Product, native, renderer, service, packaging, and performance suites are deferred because no product/runtime path changes and their W1.A05 coverage remains assigned to T01-T04, slice review, amendment exit, and W1 exit.

results.detail: The exact two-event, identified-migration, unexecuted reservation is admitted. Extra APPROVED or SUPERSEDED events; empty, invalid, or non-migration actors; bootstrap; campaign; task inventory; completion evidence/reviewer/time/exit-review control; WITHDRAWN or DEFERRED status; and a second executable owner all reject through full validate(). Adopted predecessor behavior remains green.

remediation.rootCause: The initial predicate encoded the correct endpoint states but not the exact transition cardinality or migration-identity grammar. General lifecycle validation guarantees sequential IDs and current/last agreement, so duplicate allowed-status events and an empty namespace suffix remained otherwise syntactically valid.
remediation.resolution: Require the complete ordered status vector to equal [APPROVED, SUPERSEDED], require the final actor to match governance-migration:GOV-MIG-NNNN exactly, and reject any exit_review_control in addition to the existing bootstrap, campaign, task, and completion-review/evidence denials. Full validate() regression cases cover every R01 reproduction and adjacent authority-bearing field.
remediation.recurrenceControl: The regression table mutates the canonical accepted predecessor one dimension at a time and asserts the shared hold validator rejects each malformed history or execution trace, preventing helper-only tests from masking interactions with the complete finite-state table.

rollback: Do not use the repaired materialization boundary or integrate this candidate if independent review finds a blocking defect. Preserve predecessor 492e9e6bba52e9c6087f84c1066661fd530bfdf3 as the last approved-bootstrap state: W1 remains PAUSED at ordinary Wave scope, W1.A05 remains APPROVED without tasks or a campaign, and no product execution begins.
